verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data-export or offboarding feature: no bulk export, no account-wide download, and no exit or portability documentation. The REST API returns JSON and can 'connect to any existing object', and the MCP server can access data, but these are developer building blocks for building an export yourself rather than the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
